audit_method.interpretation: Exact and near-duplicate pairs are conservative lexical flags. An unflagged or unmatched pair is not proof of scenario, entity, user, or template independence, and it is not a semantic support judgment.

comparison.exact_duplicate: Compare every case pair's ordered sequence of literal message roles and normalized per-message text, preserving message and role boundaries.

near_duplicate.scope: Cross-split only; exact-duplicate pairs are reported separately.
near_duplicate.tokenization: Split each normalized message on whitespace and union tokens across the conversation; word order, repetitions, roles, and message boundaries are ignored.

comparison.normalization: Per-message text is Unicode NFKC normalized, casefolded, and has all Unicode whitespace collapsed to single spaces.

limitations: Pairwise candidate enumeration is O(n²) in case count.
Lexical overlap cannot prove entity or user isolation.
Lexical overlap cannot prove template isolation.
This diagnostic does not establish legal permission.
This diagnostic does not assess annotation quality or sample adequacy.
No automatic Gate A approval is granted.
audit.no_memory_definition: A case whose expected claim list is empty.

limitations: All new expected claims are agent-authored provisional annotations, not independently human-validated labels.
The test split is reserved for a new comparison and is not population-representative or independently validated.

The split assignment is not stratified or balanced by domain or message count; dev has 12 three-message and 12 four-message cases, while test has 13 three-message, 9 four-message, and 2 five-message cases.
There are 8 empty-expected no-memory cases, split evenly between dev and test.
The lexical report contains no transcript text; absence of an exact or near-duplicate flag does not establish semantic independence or support.
Case-scoped entity identifiers and generic fictional users do not prove surface, user, or template isolation; the report does not grant legal permission or authorize training.
Exact structured scoring can penalize a faithful alternative extraction when it differs from the provisional gold rendering.
No automatic Gate A approval is granted.
